import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/OrbitControls.js';
import { osgbFromLocal, osgbToWgs84 } from './osgb_wgs84.js';
window.__THREE_OK = true;

const msg = document.getElementById('msg');
const hudEl = document.getElementById('hud');
const hudToggle = document.getElementById('hudToggle');
const HUD_KEY = 'sh_hud_open';
function isNarrow(){ return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 700px)').matches; }
function setHudOpen(open){
  if(!hudEl || !hudToggle) return;
  hudEl.classList.toggle('collapsed', !open);
  hudToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  hudToggle.textContent = open ? 'Controls ▾' : 'Controls ▸';
  try { sessionStorage.setItem(HUD_KEY, open ? '1' : '0'); } catch(e) {}
}
function initHudCollapse(){
  let open;
  try {
    const stored = sessionStorage.getItem(HUD_KEY);
    if (stored === '0' || stored === '1') open = stored === '1';
    else open = !isNarrow(); // default collapsed on narrow
  } catch(e) { open = !isNarrow(); }
  // On desktop CSS forces panel visible; still set aria state.
  setHudOpen(open);
  if (hudToggle) hudToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const nowOpen = hudToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
    setHudOpen(nowOpen);
  });
  // sessionStorage keeps preference across rotate; desktop CSS always shows #hud.
}
initHudCollapse();
const countsEl = document.getElementById('counts');
const LP = window.LOCKED_POSES;
if (!LP || !LP.array) {
 msg.textContent = 'Missing stone data.';
 throw new Error('no LOCKED_POSES');
}

const CE = 412245.35, CN = 142194.11;
function localXZ(e, n) { return { x: e - CE, z: -(n - CN) }; }
const SARSEN_GREY = 0x8a8e94; // elephantine grey (lighter)
const BLUESTONE = 0x6b8cae; // unchanged
const ALTAR = 0xff69b4; // unchanged pink
const MARKER_SILVER = 0xf0f4fa; // 92/94 markers only (bright silver)

function colourFor(e) {
 const id = String(e.id);
 // Markers win over pose colour_class (e.g. gold_medium / seed).
 if (id === '92' || id === '94') return MARKER_SILVER;
 if (e.colour_class === 'blue_bluestone') return BLUESTONE;
 if (id === '80' || e.colour_class === 'altar_pink') return ALTAR;
 return SARSEN_GREY;
}

const byClass = {};
for (const e of LP.array) byClass[e.colour_class] = (byClass[e.colour_class] || 0) + 1;
countsEl.textContent = (LP.count || LP.array.length) + ' stones';

const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x2a3548);
const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xc9d4e8, 0x3d4a3a, 0.72);
scene.add(hemi);
const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe2a8, 1.35);
sunLight.position.set(40, 60, 20);
scene.add(sunLight);
scene.add(sunLight.target);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8aa0b8, 0.35);
fill.position.set(-30, 40, -20);
scene.add(fill);

const root = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(root);
